title.en: An Act Granting Monetary Reward to Any Person Who Shall Locate or Find the Remains of the Late Governor Hilario Abellana of Cebu

text.en: Any person who shall locate or find the remains of the late Governor Hilario Abellana of Cebu shall be granted a reward of five thousand pesos.
The sum of five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: July 20, 1948.
